newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot Q3 same store sales up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot Q3 same store sales up 7 pct.

text.p: Home Depot said Tuesday that comparable store sales were up 7 percent from the previous year and that average customer sale rose 1 percent.

"We are quite pleased with the financial performance for the quarter and year-to-date," said Home Depot Chief Executive Bernard Marcus. "We are well on our way toward generating another year of outstanding financial results and earnings."
The company today reported third quarter earnings of $0.46 per share on sales of $4.922 billion. The First Call consensus estimate for third quarter earnings was $0.46 per share.
